name: Wind Ward
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Uncheck a Condition. If you did, you create swirling winds out to short range. Distribute five +1 Defense bonuses among creatures within range as you choose. If the condition you unchecked was Troubled, distribute one additional +1 Defense bonus.

When a creature with one of these bonuses is hit by an attack, you may check another Condition to maintain that bonus; otherwise, that creature loses it. If a creature moves outside the range of the spell, it loses the bonuses.

On your turn, you may spend a half action to redistribute any remaining bonuses among creatures within range.
